purpose: Test a fixed leave-second-reference contrast as source-necessity reranking across pointwise and embedding VLM scorers.
candidate_contribution: A cross-domain transfer of contrastive/log-ratio calibration to multi-reference composed image retrieval, adapted to a semantically interpretable missing-source control and evaluated against explicit negatives.
cohort: The same 48 P030 development components; no reserved component or held-out image is accessed.

conditions.counterfactual: the identical instruction and first reference, with the second reference image omitted

models.qwen2.5_vl_7b_pointwise: raw True-minus-False margin from P030 labelled_dual and labelled_single
models.qwen2.5_vl_3b_embedding: float32 cosine from P031 base3b dual and single
models.coral_3b_embedding: float32 cosine from P031 coral dual and single

ranking: Stable descending sort of raw RNCR scores over the frozen top20; ranks 21-50 remain unchanged.
mechanism: macro per-query AUC of delta2 for positives versus explicit negatives
mean positive delta2 minus mean explicit-negative delta2

continuation_gate.meaning: Eligibility to freeze a new untouched confirmation; not significance, novelty, or SOTA.

novelty_position: Prior contrastive decoding and calibration make the algebra non-novel in isolation.

The potential contribution is the first task-specific use of a missing-reference necessity contrast for multi-reference composed retrieval, plus source-wise explicit-negative validation and required-source aggregation.
A publishable claim requires a nontrivial multi-source extension, untouched confirmation, official-comparable baselines, and at least two model families.
limits: Posthoc exploratory analysis on a 48-query Composition-only development cohort.
Omitting the second image changes input length and semantics; delta2 is an operational source-necessity contrast, not an identified causal effect.
Top20 reranking is not a full PinPoint or SOTA evaluation.
No alpha sweep is permitted in P034.
